content: Two recurring theming pitfalls: (1) FOUC/flash-of-unstyled-theme on load, caused by SSR rendering a default theme before client-side theme resolution overrides it — fixed by resolving the theme server-side before first paint (no client flash-fix script needed if resolution happens in the server component/layout, as Mercora's getActiveTheme() design already does). (2) Hardcoded colors that only break in one theme: borders that vanish (dark-on-near-black), muted text failing contrast, any component bypassing tokens — this is precisely the risk the milestone's full component/template token sweep is meant to close, and why the light preset is called out as the 'acid test' for sweep completeness.
